items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: When I found out that my son had talent for Art, he could draw, I insisted that he went to art school.

ctx.x: Yeah. Nobody knew it but Joe Glaser. And two or three times, I had guys studying with me, and I found out they wasn't advancing, and I told them, "Forget it. Find something else." On one instrument, I know I proved myself... When I found out that my son had talent for Art, he could draw, I insisted that he went to art school. And he went to art school when he was still going to art school, and he went on to be a good artist.
A great commercial artist. He sure did. Billy(?) Thomas. He did album covers, right?
